entries.title: Sexual Reference Pattern
entries.description: Sexual Reference reasoning pattern for the reference bucket.
direct_expressions: إشارة جنسية
Sexual Reference إشارة جنسية
supporting_evidence: Sexual Reference appears in the literal text or scene direction.
The context supports the reference reading.
contradictory_evidence: The text is purely neutral and lacks sexual meaning.
The story explicitly condemns the line or uses it as evidence.
false_positives: A neutral description of a body part or garment.
A medical or educational explanation with no flirtation or insinuation.
counter_examples: A line that appears suggestive but is later clarified as literal housekeeping.
A symbolic image with no recoverable sexual meaning.
cross_sentence_indicators: Later dialogue confirms the sexual meaning.
The neighboring sentence changes the interpretation.
reviewer_guidance: Double meanings should be checked against speaker, target, and neighboring lines.
Metaphor and symbolism count only when the sexual reference is recoverable from context.
Do not collapse reference, joke, and symbolism into one node.

confidence_modifiers.title: Direct Signal
confidence_modifiers.description: The sexual meaning is explicit in the literal span.

confidence_modifiers.title: Contextual Signal
confidence_modifiers.description: The sexual meaning is implied by context, framing, or later dialogue.

examples.expected_outcome: The reviewer should use context to evaluate sexual reference.

entries.title: Sexual Flirting Pattern
entries.description: Sexual Flirting reasoning pattern for the relational bucket.
direct_expressions: غزل أو دعوة حميمة
Sexual Flirting غزل أو دعوة حميمة
indirect_expressions: Sexual Flirting إيحاء بعلاقة أو رغبة
supporting_evidence: Sexual Flirting appears in the literal text or scene direction.
The context supports the relational reading.
contradictory_evidence: The text is purely neutral and lacks sexual meaning.
The story explicitly condemns the line or uses it as evidence.
false_positives: Family affection mistaken for intimacy.
A casual compliment or dance that is not sexualized by the scene.
counter_examples: Two characters holding hands in a family scene.
A polite invitation to talk with no erotic signal.
cross_sentence_indicators: Later dialogue confirms the sexual meaning.
The neighboring sentence changes the interpretation.
reviewer_guidance: Do not assume intent from a single affectionate line.
Check whether the scene shows mutual consent, pressure, or ambiguity.
Differentiate flirting from harassment and from ordinary romance.

entries.title: Sexual Harassment Pattern
entries.description: Sexual Harassment reasoning pattern for the harm bucket.
direct_expressions: تحرش أو اعتداء أو استغلال
Sexual Harassment تحرش أو اعتداء أو استغلال
indirect_expressions: Sexual Harassment ضغط أو استدراج أو ابتزاز
supporting_evidence: Sexual Harassment appears in the literal text or scene direction.
The context supports the harm reading.
contradictory_evidence: The text is purely neutral and lacks sexual meaning.
The story explicitly condemns the line or uses it as evidence.
false_positives: A police report repeating a harmful allegation as evidence.
A story condemning abuse rather than endorsing it.
counter_examples: A consensual couple scene with no pressure.
A courtroom denial of a false accusation.
cross_sentence_indicators: Later dialogue confirms the sexual meaning.
The neighboring sentence changes the interpretation.
reviewer_guidance: Harassment is distinct from flirtation.
Assault is distinct from suggestion.
